title: 3D Asymmetric Block Stacking & Torque Toppling
description: A 2.5 kg 3D wooden block is placed atop a 3D support pedestal with its 3D center of mass overhanging the support polygon edge (dx=0.34 m, dy=0.08 m vs 0.25 m half-width), triggering a 3D torque-induced rotational topple onto the rigid floor.
tavily_query: coefficient of static friction wood on wood physical constant
laws_tested: Center of mass & 3D support polygon torque stability
Contact constraints (3D non-penetration with pedestal and floor)
Gravity and free-fall behavior during 3D toppling arc
Conservation of linear and angular momentum on impact
